title: Mage in Mystic City
description: A Black female mage in a sleek black armored bodysuit leaps mid-air above glowing blue and pink magical circles. She holds a glowing pink lantern in one hand while casting golden sparks with the other, positioned in front of a vibrant green stylized city with spiraling towers under a purple night sky with crescent moons and constellations.
prompt: A dynamic scene of a young Black woman with short curly hair wearing a black futuristic armored suit, leaping through the air above glowing concentric blue and pink magic circles. She casts golden sparks from her right hand and holds a glowing pink lantern in her left. Behind her is a vibrant green stylized fantasy city with spiraling organic towers and houses under a deep purple starry night sky featuring crescent moons and constellation lines. Tree roots and branches emerge from the ground around her. Colorful paint splatter border in orange, green and purple.
